comments.author: @ElEvangelioPutrefacto44
comments.text: Fun fact: The first European to reach Tawantinsuyu (the Inca Empire) was Alejo García, a Portuguese sailor who was shipwrecked in Brazil. When he heard about the riches of the Inca Empire, he organized an army of Guaraní warriors and attacked Charcas (present-day Bolivia), carrying off a considerable amount of gold and silver while evading the army sent by Huayna Cápac (the ruling Inca at the time) to confront him. Alejo was killed by local indigenous people while returning to Brazil with his loot, but he remains the first European to ever set foot on Inca territory.

Everyone talks about the Incas, but Peru/South America Literally has A LOT of other civilizations and Literally a 5,000 year history!
(Just as old as Egypt and Mesopotamia)

The Incas are literally just the very tip of the iceberg.

These other civilizations, empires, and cultures include…
The Nazca, Paracas, Moche, Sican, Chimu Empire, The Chachapoyas, Tiawanaku Empire, Huari Empire, Chavin culture, Sechin culture, etc…

Also the oldest civilizations such as The Norte Chico Civilization not only had No Wheels or writing, but also has NO POTTERY either. They mainly used baskets and gourds to carry stuff. Also they built Pyramids and some of which are OLDER Than The Egyptian Pyramids.

So yeah Peru is a fascinating place to say the least!
